extracted.intended_audience: scientists, academics, and professional applicants reading Nature (potential applicants for advertised positions)
extracted.subtask_short: applying for academic and instructor posts
extracted.subtask_description: Notices and advertisements for academic chairs and instructional appointments, listing eligibility, salary, application format, deadlines, and preferences for candidates (e.g., University chairs, RAF education officers, Royal Navy instructor lieutenants). Useful for preparing and submitting applications for such posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: RAF Education Officer eligibility and application requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are invited for vacant appointments as Education Officers, Grade III and Grade IV, on the Educational Staffs of various Royal Air Force establishments; principal subjects of instruction are English, Practical Mathematics, Applied Mechanics and Drawing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Salary scales are provisional and under reconsideration; allowances up to ten increments of the scale can be made for previous experience and war service. Preference will be given to candidates who have served as commissioned officers in any of the three Services. Applications must be made on A.M. Form 69, which, together with further particulars, can be obtained from the SECRETARY, A.E., Air Ministry, Kingsway, London, W.C.2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royal Navy Instructor Lieutenant eligibility and terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are invited for appointments as Instructor Lieutenants in the Royal Navy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates must be under 30 years of age, have had a University Training, and have taken an Honours Degree in Mathematics, Science or Engineering. Present rates of pay are given (from £365 per annum on entry to a maximum of £949 per annum as Instructor Commander). Promotion by selection to Instructor Captain is open. Retired pay may be granted to officers over 40 with minimum service; service victualling, cabin accommodation, and servant are provided or allowances in lieu. An allowance of £50 towards necessary uniform is payable on satisfactory completion of probationary service. For further particulars apply to the SECRETARY OF THE ADMIRALTY, Whitehall, S.W.1.

rubrics_metrics.name: University of Sydney — Chair of Zoology application instructions and terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are invited for the Chair of Zoology (University of Sydney). Salary (fixed) £1100 per annum, and £150 allowed for travelling expenses to Sydney from Europe. Duties commence March 1, 1923.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Further details of terms may be obtained from the under-signed. Applications (in sextuplicate), stating age and qualifications, accompanied by reference and copies of testimonials, should be sent not later than the stated deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: University of Cape Town — Chair of Inorganic Chemistry appointment terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are invited for the Chair of Inorganic Chemistry at the University of Cape Town, vacant from March 1, 1923. The salary for a man is £900 per annum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Professor must become a member of the University Teachers’ Superannuation Fund. Appointments are generally restricted to candidates under 35 years of age, but in the case of a candidate who has been engaged in teaching or in research in South Africa this restriction need not apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application routing and contact instructions for advertised posts
rubrics_metrics.description: Where to obtain application forms and to whom applications/enquiries should be sent for the various advertised posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RAF Education Officers: obtain A.M. Form 69 and further particulars from the SECRETARY, A.E., Air Ministry, Kingsway, London, W.C.2. Royal Navy Instructor Lieutenants: apply to the SECRETARY OF THE ADMIRALTY, Whitehall, S.W.1. University posts: further particulars obtainable from the under-signed or specified university office; applications must include specified enclosures (references, testimonials) and required number of copies (e.g., sextuplicate for University of Sydney).
